crs_confidence_rule.axis_order_verified: a SEPARATE question from CRS confidence: MCGD's axis order is verified from its LAT/LONG column names plus a physical-impossibility check while its CRS stays 'unknown'; those two facts do not conflict
crs_confidence_rule.crs_confidence: how sure we are the coordinates really are EPSG:4326: confirmed = the source states WGS84 (CHGIS .prj, Pleiades gis_README.md); inferred = no explicit statement, but the format specification mandates WGS84 AND the file conforms to that specification (RFC 7946 GeoJSON -> WHG's JSON-LD records); being merely GeoJSON-SHAPED is not enough, so WHG's older flat schema (geoms[].coordinates present, but no @context and no crs member) is 'unknown'; unknown = neither, i.e. MCGD (no datum declared) and those WHG flat rows; plausible numbers are a sanity check, not CRS evidence
crs_confidence_rule.original_crs: what the source declares; 'unknown' when it declares nothing
crs_confidence_rule.per_row: crs_confidence is decided per location row, not per source: WHG carries inferred for its 5 conformant GeoJSON rows and unknown for its 3 GeoJSON-shaped plain-JSON rows, and every 'unknown' row also carries quality_flag 'crs_unknown' plus an 'unknown_crs' warning issue

1.english: Year is set according to a pan-Dynastic period, such as "Qin Han," or " Song Yuan"

2.english: Year is set according to a Dynastic period, such as "Tang," or " Ming"

3.english: Year is set according to a Dynastic Title or Reign Period, such as "Shundi," or "Zhizheng"

4.english: Year is specified, such as "13th Year of the Kangxi Reign Period"

5.english: Season or Month is specified, such as "4th month of the Lunar year," or "autumn"

6.english: Date is specified, such as "jiachen day, 5th month, 14th Year of the Jiaqing Reign Period"

9.english: Dated is set to a specific year based on the source materials used, not based on the valid span of time for the historical place [both Begin and End values will be the same]

time_bound_type_denominator.note: what the record-level time_bound_type distribution counts: every CHGIS record, every MCGD source row, and every Pleiades/WHG child row that is attached to a place inside the slice. Pleiades/WHG place rows are excluded (they carry no years of their own) and so are orphan child rows, whose parents fall outside the 1 MB slice.
